---
title: MIR 1.1.0 direct F200/F210 successor fixture
---

This private fixture consumes only the protected published MIR 1.1.0 F200 source save made by `f200-110-source`. Its source directory is new, but each wrapper deliberately retains the source fixture mod name and storage key: Factorio scopes saved `storage` to that mod identity, so a differently named observer could not read the protected source state. It has distinct F200 and direct F210 Base package versions; it does not use an intervening MIR5 F200 save, a Space Age repair route, or a current roster assertion.

Before candidate work, it validates the complete saved 31-row source roster, exact published 75-effect multiset snapshots, earned source recipe bonuses, the worker-robot-battery force contribution, all 42 original startup values, native zero manual-mining fields, foreign queued `.42`, and detached `.27` state. Current-only MIR5 additions remain unearned and outside the historical source roster. The current public module row is independently required to retain its normal nine effects; the three historical tier-one `.01` effects must instead be present as separate hidden earned holders at the saved completed level.

After that read-only preflight, it accelerates and observes exactly one real candidate gear laboratory completion, checks the resulting level and gear bonus, saves once, and requires two cold reloads. It consumes only the protected r05 source save; its candidate package is bound separately after a coherent source/player/archive freeze. This fixture is preparation only, not native migration acceptance or a current package result.
